# Crucible crane over the lava pool: an iron post and arm, a chain of chunky links (exaggerated: each
# link 0.16 wide, two splats; real links would vanish) and a crucible that swings on it. Rigid: chain
# and crucible are one object whose origin is the hook at the arm's tip; +-7 degrees in a 3 s loop.
# Up Z; the arm points along +X, its tip 1.0 m out (placed over the pool's centre in the scene).
new
fps 12
frame range 0 36
material new Iron --base-color 0.020 0.122 0.224 --no-slot
material new Chain --base-color 0.290 0.141 0.502 --no-slot
material new Melt --base-color 1.0 0.557 0.502 --emission 1.0 0.557 0.502 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Post --size 1 --location 0 0 1.1
scale 0.2 0.2 2.2
apply --scale
material assign Iron
add mesh cube --name Arm --size 1 --location 0.5 0 2.12
scale 1.2 0.14 0.14
apply --scale
material assign Iron
add mesh cube --name Brace --size 1 --location 0.25 0 1.85
scale 0.62 0.1 0.1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -40 0
apply --rotation
material assign Iron
select Post Arm Brace
active Post
join
# chain: links alternating flat and edge-on, 0.2 m apart, from the hook (1.0, 0, 2.05) down to 1.05
add mesh cube --name L0 --size 1 --location 1.0 0 1.95
scale 0.16 0.07 0.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name L1 --size 1 --location 1.0 0 1.75
scale 0.07 0.16 0.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name L2 --size 1 --location 1.0 0 1.55
scale 0.16 0.07 0.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name L3 --size 1 --location 1.0 0 1.35
scale 0.07 0.16 0.2
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name L4 --size 1 --location 1.0 0 1.15
scale 0.16 0.07 0.2
apply --scale
select L0 L1 L2 L3 L4
material assign Chain
# crucible: a tapered 6-sided pot, its molten top glowing
add mesh cone --name Pot --vertices 6 --radius1 0.17 --radius2 0.26 --depth 0.36 --location 1.0 0 0.87
material assign Iron
active Pot
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Melt
mode object
select L0 L1 L2 L3 L4 Pot
active Pot
join
rename Pot Crucible
cursor set 1.0 0 2.05
origin set --to cursor
select Crucible
frame set 0
set rotation -7 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 18
set rotation 7 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 36
set rotation -7 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 0
select all
shade flat
export crane.glb --bake-animations
